Root.description:
Groups all OTP field parts and manages their state.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled OTP value when the component is initially rendered.

props.name: value
props.description: The OTP value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the OTP value changes. The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the change: `'input-change'` for typing or autofill`'input-clear'` when a character is removed by text input`'input-paste'` for paste interactions`'keyboard'` for keyboard interactions that change the value

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The input autocomplete attribute. Applied to the first slot and hidden validation input.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Whether to submit the owning form when the OTP becomes complete.

props.name: form
props.description:
A string specifying the `form` element with which the hidden input is associated.
This string's value must match the id of a `form` element in the same document.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: The virtual keyboard hint applied to the slot inputs and hidden validation input. Built-in validation modes provide sensible defaults, but you can override them when needed.

props.name: length*
props.description:
The number of OTP input slots.
Required so the root can clamp values, detect completion, and generate
consistent validation markup before all slots hydrate.

props.name: mask
props.description:
Whether the slot inputs should mask entered characters.
Pass `type` directly to individual `<OTPField.Input>` parts to use a custom
input type.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description:
Function that normalizes the OTP value after whitespace and `validationType` filtering.
It runs whenever OTP Field normalizes a value, including initial/default values, controlled
values, and user edits. The returned value is filtered by `validationType` again, then clamped to `length`.
It should be idempotent because OTP Field may normalize the same value more than once while
handling edits, storing state, and rendering controlled or uncontrolled values. Non-idempotent
normalizers can compound across those normalization passes. Characters rejected while
normalizing typed or pasted text are reported through `onValueInvalid`.

props.name: onValueComplete
props.description:
Callback function that is fired when the OTP value becomes complete, or when a complete value
is pasted while the OTP is already complete. When the value changes, it runs later than `onValueChange`, after the internal value update is
applied. If a complete pasted value matches the current value, `onValueChange` does not fire. If `autoSubmit` is enabled, it runs immediately before the owning form is submitted.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description:
Callback fired when entered text contains characters that are rejected by validation or
normalization before the OTP value updates. The `value` argument is the attempted user-entered string before normalization.

props.name: validationType
props.description: The type of input validation to apply to the OTP value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to change the field value.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must enter a value before submitting a form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id of the first input element.
Subsequent inputs derive their ids from it (`{id}-2`, `{id}-3`, and so on).

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field is in a valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field is in an invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when all slots are filled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the OTP field contains at least one character.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when one of the OTP field inputs is focused.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ChangeEventDetails
Root.CompleteEventDetails
Root.InvalidEventDetails
